note: The published set 'standard' (0.6.0): every document fixed here, so batch --set standard and the salt in its answer keys make the same set again. Each type's scenarios are taken with seeds set-1 to set-N; on a type with layout variants, seed i takes the base layout or a variant in turn (base, then the type's ids in order); every degradeEvery-th seed is a degraded copy, the presets in turn; the 835 is written beside every document of a type that has one. The same rotation for every scenario, so layout and preset say nothing about the scenario.
name: standard
